scripts.build: npm run generate-search-index && node scripts/build-sitemap.js && next build
scripts.seo:audit: npm run seo:validate && npm run sitemap:build
scripts.rebuild: npm run clear-all-cache && npm run build
scripts.reset: npm run clear-all-cache && npm run dev
scripts.revalidate:name: node scripts/revalidate-name.js
scripts.cf:build: NEXT_STATIC_NAME_LIMIT=2500 npm run build && NEXT_STATIC_NAME_LIMIT=2500 opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.cf:preview: NEXT_STATIC_NAME_LIMIT=2500 npm run cf:build && wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy: NEXT_STATIC_NAME_LIMIT=2500 npm run cf:build && wrangler deploy
